name: Australian Centre for the Moving Image
wiki: Australian Centre for the Moving Image
bio_draft: film, television, games and new media museum with cinemas, in Federation Square.

name: Arts Centre Melbourne
bio_draft: concert hall, theatres and the Arts Centre spire; tours and performances on most days.

name: St Patrick's Cathedral
bio_draft: Gothic Revival cathedral begun in the 1850s, open to visitors on weekdays.

name: St Paul's Cathedral
bio_draft: Gothic revival cathedral on Flinders Street, open daily to visitors.

name: Fitzroy Gardens
bio_draft: historic gardens with an avenue of English elms and a conservatory, next to Cooks' Cottage.

name: Cooks' Cottage
bio_draft: the parents' cottage of Captain James Cook, moved to Fitzroy Gardens, open daily with entry fee.
